questions.title: Language Club - Part 1

metadata.scenario:
You are a new member of the Language Club. Fill in the form. Write in sentences. Use 20–30 words. Recommended time: 7 minutes.
Tell me your free time and interests?

questions.stem: You are a member of the language club. You are talking to three other members in the language club chat room. Use 30 - 40 words.

questions.prompt: Why did you choose this course?
questions.sample_answer: This course is essential for my current job. I also want to meet new people to expand my network. The best way to network is to attend language clubs.

questions.prompt: How have you found the course so far? What has been challenging?
questions.sample_answer: I find this course exciting and valuable. During the course, I have learned a lot. I had some difficulties when I had to speak in front of a crowd.

questions.prompt: What are you hoping to do when you finish the course?
questions.sample_answer: At the end of the course, I hope my language skills will improve and be more confident. I will apply the knowledge and skills gained from this course at work.
